item.description: Fresh fighting has erupted along the Thailand-Cambodia border, fuelling fears that Southeast Asian efforts to revive a ceasefire could be undermined, even as foreign ministers meet in Malaysia to seek a way forward.

item.title: Bangladesh Students’ League calls for neutral administration ahead of 2026 polls
item.description: The Bangladesh Students’ League has urged the international community to help ensure Bangladesh’s February 12, 2026 general election is held under a neutral administration, calling it essential for a free, fair and inclusive poll.
